testPolicy.text: Official SAT, ACT or CLT scores are required of first-year applicants (CDS C8A for fall 2027: SAT or ACT required to be considered; C8F: the CLT can be submitted as an alternative). SAT and ACT scores are valid if taken within the last five years; the ACT Science section is optional.

cost.totalIncludes: Office of Student Financial Assistance, Fall and Spring 2026-2027 undergraduate cost of attendance, main and regional campuses, living on campus, based on 28 credit hours: tuition and fees (including the $10 annual ID fee), books, housing 8,750, food 6,170, transportation, personal expenses. No separate required fees: Florida bills fees inside the per-credit tuition.

inState.note: CDS 2025-26 G1 lists 2026-27 tuition of 6,368 for 30 credit hours (per credit 212.28) and food and housing of 12,436 (double room and maximum meal plan basis)

facts.text: For fall 2025, UCF admitted 21,823 of 46,049 Florida applicants and 3,124 of 11,215 out-of-state applicants; 7,417 of the 8,103 enrolled first-years were Floridians.
For summer and fall 2026 combined, UCF reports 70,030 applications and 28,612 students admitted, with a middle 50% SAT of 1310-1420, ACT of 28-32 and GPA of 4.11-4.57 among admitted students.

Students who meet every Early Action deadline (October 15) get priority consideration for merit scholarships, and UCF warns that scholarship funding for first-year students is usually exhausted by mid-January.
Letters of recommendation are neither required nor considered in UCF's general first-year admission process.
DirectConnect to UCF guarantees admission, consistent with university policy, to students who finish an associate degree (A.A.) or a statewide articulated A.S. at a partner state college.
For fall 2025, 2,157 students accepted a place on UCF's waiting list and 343 of them were admitted.

notes: C1 from CDS 2025-26 (PDF uploaded July 2026; an earlier March 2026 upload also exists): applied 25,767 men + 33,853 women + 9 unknown = 59,629; admitted 11,777 + 13,743 + 2 = 25,522; enrolled 4,123 + 3,979 + 1 = 8,103. The 2026 admitted profile (70,030 / 28,612) counts summer and fall 2026 applications as UCF's admissions office reports them, not a CDS C1 count, so it is kept as a fact and not as cycleNewer. Cost from the 2026-27 cost of attendance page (28 credit hours); the CDS G1 figures (30 credit hours) are in the notes of each column. No institution-wide aid promise found; Florida's Bright Futures is a state program and was not verified on an official page. C21: no Early Decision; C22: Early Action closing 10/15, notification 12/4, not restrictive.
